groups.title: Compact IQ2 storage and compatible layouts — C04/C25

Screen the revised compatible IQ2 nibble layout selectively; preserve decoded weights, scale/SiLU boundaries and reduction order. Keep the first incompatible revision deferred.

groups.title: Measurement and correctness requirements — apply to every candidate

subtasks.text: Evaluate per-window acceptance/dispatch tracing from Strata #3631 and pinned-stage per-stream fences from #3483.
Use same-day ABBA comparisons at short/4K/16K/32K with identical model, chunks, ring, residency, memory budgets and prefix state.
Record accepted tokens/s, prefill/TTFT, draft/verify time, acceptance, PCIe traffic, graph/temporary bytes, cache slots, clocks and variance; separate profiling from serving timing.
Check exact bytes where expected; otherwise teacher-forced scores/KL and task quality. Run kv1188 and appropriate CUDA sanitizers.
Extend coverage to real activation outliers, FP64 scale references, FP32 attention accumulation, fixed reduction order, accepted recurrent-state tails and request-local sampling.
Test expert IDs above 255, empty/ragged groups, owner/version changes, counter wrap, WMMA alignment, poisoned scratch, shuffled pages and changing-input replay.
Distinguish cold/warm prefixes, inspect logit margins, preserve natural EOS and test threshold/chunk/capacity boundaries.
Build touched CUDA/HIP/SYCL backends where available; explicitly record unavailable runtime/compiler coverage.
Commit and locally opt in only qualified improvements, smoke-test the installed release and retain rollback/evidence. A rejected experiment is a completed investigation, not an adopted optimization.

groups.title: Expert dispatch by format and shape

subtasks.text: Run the 90-case mode-0/4/8 screen and mode-8 engine ABBA; no consistent overall decode gain was established.
Finish the v19 default-versus-explicit-0/4/8 comparison, including mode 4's missing large-down fallback; investigate the anomalous 4K prefill result.
Use measured production route frequencies and full-call costs to select opt-in format/shape cells; include GU/epilogue/down and input conversion costs.
Validate numerics, teacher-forced output, acceptance and accepted tokens/s before promotion.

groups.title: Host transfers and KV copy work — C11–C13

subtasks.text: Compare mapped-host expert reads with bounded DMA during concurrent compute, including small decode misses and expert-cache displacement.
Measure occupied-range cold-expert and QSA DMA for large contiguous runs; retain mapped gathers for fragmented/small selections and calibrate local thresholds.
Increase small-miss copy-plan parallelism only where complete cache-resolution time improves.
Skip KV value reads only when the values cannot be consumed; preserve alignment and unsupported-case fallbacks.
Consider omitting host-KV zeroing only after proving reads follow writes across padding, reuse and graph replay.
Audit pin registration, initialization, stream ownership and fences; reuse existing staged prefill and chunk balancing.

groups.title: KV cache policy and bounded history — C14/C15

subtasks.text: Compare probe-LRU under shared-prefix reuse and disjoint-context churn while retaining K8V4 encoded storage.

Measure compact recurrent state and bounded expert leases, including persistent bytes and ownership/version changes.
Profile grouped expert projections and mixed dense fusion only where Strata has an uncovered operation.
Screen grouped draft-output Q8 warps, whole-batch HC and reuse of canonical HC RMS statistics.
Identify specific width/chain-policy gaps with per-window traces, structured outputs, changing context and accepted-token costs.
Require complete verifier-round improvement, including target work, sampling and state commit; do not duplicate existing adaptive drafting.

groups.title: Dense weight reuse for T=9–16 — C01

subtasks.text: Proceed only if lookup profiling shows material T=9–16 work.
Decode each packed weight once while preserving independent FP32 accumulators and each row's reduction order.
Include quantization/interleave and complete pipeline costs in comparisons against group16; retain the slow large-Q5_K-head fallback.
Keep M=17–32 FP8/QPN8 reuse in the future-format work; do not expand verifier capacity merely to exercise a kernel.
After the storage correction, trace actual native scoring admission and distinguish prefill from verifier/decode routes.
Compare native scoring with cuBLAS plus exact top-k only on material large-prefill shapes; preserve ties and causal tails.
Screen narrower pre-Ampere tiles and only uncovered 2–8-query shared-key reuse; account for corrected upstream performance attribution.

Profile the remaining p.v loads/scales and launch bounds on D256 attention. The adopted K8V4 kernel already keeps its p.v accumulator in registers (`acc[8][4]`); any further register use must preserve measured occupancy and exact numerics.
Audit register pressure/spills where shared memory already limits occupancy; avoid global launch-cap changes.
Validate separate sm70/sm75 accumulator maps, grouped heads, strides, ragged/shuffled pages, device scratch admission and compiled-kernel fallback.

Prototype native CUDA with no transposed-K copy, shared A/P lifetime reuse and loop-end synchronization, following the newer #1228 design.
Verify final FP32 recurrent state across chunk boundaries and speculative commits.
Admit by actual shared-memory capacity; test high-register variants only where occupancy is already constrained.
Measure complete preparation, recurrence and output costs plus displaced expert-cache slots; prior 4–7x-slower kernels remain rejected.
Extend measured solo-graph lifetimes/free-memory deltas to batch graphs and arena ownership; distinguish owned bytes from allocator deltas.
Prototype and test bounded solo-graph LRU. Caps 2/3 were not adopted; archive their exact patches, quality results and regressions.
Explore same-size updates, common padded topology and batch reuse; direct cross-size updates failed CUDA's equal-node-count requirement.
Include recurring preparation/recapture cost in lookup-policy measurements.
Test padded CPU/GDN/KV state, mixed prefill/decode, concurrency, eviction/recreation, changing inputs and low-memory fallback.
Measure full rounds and graph-padding inflation separately from draft time.
Seek lookup-16 memory savings without shrinking prompt chunks or raising reserve; 75–100 MiB remains a target, not an established production saving.
